title: Principal axes of the covariance matrix
caption: The covariance matrix [[5, 2], [2, 2]] has eigenvalue 6 along (2, 1) and eigenvalue 1 along (−1, 2). The axes are perpendicular, PC1 carries 6 of the total variance 7 (6/7 ≈ 85.7%), and PC2 carries 1.
alt: Two perpendicular directions from the origin: PC1 along (2, 1), drawn with length 3 times that of PC2 along (−1, 2), and a right angle between them.
description: C(2, 1) = (12, 6) = 6(2, 1): PC1 is the direction (2, 1) with variance 6.
C(−1, 2) = (−1, 2) = 1(−1, 2): PC2 is the perpendicular direction with variance 1.

checks.name: C(2, 1) = 6(2, 1) checked in the batch: variance 6/7 = 85.7%
